Amendment Application (IA No.1 of 2026)
3. Today, the matter is listed on 
Amendment Application IA No. 01 of 2026, 
by which petitioner wants to bring out 
certain amendment in Prayer Clause-ii.
4. Learned State Counsel has no objection 
if the amendment application is allowed.
5. Having heard the learned counsel for 
the parties and having perused the 
amendment application, this Court is of the 
opinion that no prejudice would be caused if 
the amendment application is allowed.
6. Accordingly, amendment application
(IA/1/2026) is allowed. 7. Let necessary amendment be 
incorporated in the prayer clause, by 
supplying amended memo of prayer clause
within three days.
8. List this case on 11.08.2026 as fresh.
 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)

Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Sudha Tamta, learned counsel 
holding brief of Mr. Vinay Kumar,
learned counsel for petitioner.
2. Mr. Anil Dabral, learned Additional 
C.S.C. with Mr. Prem Prakash Bhatt, 
learned Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand/respondents.
3. Petitioner, who is working as 
Nursing Officer (Female) at B.D. Pandey 
District Government Hospital, claims 
benefit of Maternity Leave for her third 
child.
4. Learned State Counsel submits that 
as per the government order, the benefit 
of Maternity Leave can only be extended 
for only two children born to the 
government servant, and since the 
petitioner delivered the third child, 
therefore, in accordance with the 
government order, she was denied the 
benefit of Maternity Leave.
5. He further submits that after 
delivering birth to the third child on 
24.02.2025, petitioner has already 
joined her service on 17.06.2025 and  she had been sanctioned 75 days of 
Medical Leave w.e.f. 01.04.2025 to 
15.06.2025.
6. Learned State Counsel prays for and 
is granted four weeks’ time to file 
counter affidavit.
7. Put up on 16.09.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 11.08.2026
PN
